0.0: 본부로부터 당신에게 지령이 내려왔습니다. 지금 확인하시겠습니까?

yes.0: 지령의 내용은 '파티퀘스트. 요원C. 첩보문서 5개' 이상입니다. 무슨 말인지 잘 이해가 안가신다구요? 그러니까 이 지령의 뜻은 파티퀘스트에서 첩보문서 5개를 모아서 파티퀘스트 보상지역에 있는 요원C를 찾아가라는 거예요.
yes.1: 요원C는 정보처리를 담당하고 있는데 현재 현장임무를 수행하기 위해 파티퀘스트에 파견되어 있거든요. 파티퀘스트에 출몰하는 몬스터들이 '마스터M'의 수하들이라는 첩보가 있었어요. 이 몬스터들을 조사해서 첩보문서 5개를 얻으면 요원C를 찾아가 보세요.
yes.2: 요원C가 어디 있냐구요? 당신이 파티퀘스트를 훌륭히 수행한다면 그를 만날 수 있을거예요.

QuestInfo.name: Agent C's Intelligence Activity
QuestInfo.0: Gaga sent you a strange message.
QuestInfo.1:
Secret Agent Gaga tells you to collect 5 Intelligence documents from party quests and then meet Agent C. 

#b<Party Quests where you can find Agent C>
- Moon Bunny's Rice Cake: Level 10 or higher
- First Time Together: Level 21 - Level 30
- Crack of Dimension: Level 35 - Level 50
- Tower of the Goddess: Level 51 - Level 70
- Lord Pirate: Level 55 - Level 100
- Romeo and Juliet: Level 71 - Level 85
- Poisonous Fog Forest: Level 45 - Level 55

 #kEach time you retrieve 5 Intelligence documents you will receive #bAgent C's old Receiver#k, and when you retrieve 100 Intelligence documents, you will receive #bAgent C's Titanium Titanium Receiver#k.
QuestInfo.2: Secret Agent Gaga suggested that you go see Agent C at the reward map once you get 5 Intelligence documents from the party quest.

1.0: I have been waiting for you.  Your mission is to investigate the monsters that appear in the party quest and bring back 5 Intelligence documents.  Everything is in your hands.

npc.0: Go see Agent C in the party quest.

0.0: An order was sent to you from headquarters.  Do you want to check it now?

yes.0: The order says #r'Party Quest. Agent C. 5 Intelligence documents'#k. In other words, collect #b5 Intelligence documents#k inside the party quest and take them to #rAgent C#k at the party quest reward area.
yes.1: There is intelligence that the monsters inside the party quest are #e#rMaster M's#k#n subordinates. Collect 5 Intelligence documents from these monsters and take them to Agent C.
yes.2: Where is Agent C? If you successfully get through the party quest, you will meet him. You can get #bAgent C's Old Receiver#k for every 5 Intelligence Documents you bring, and for every hundred you can get #bAgent C's Titanium Receiver#k.
